title: Indiana Avenue's 18th-20th block, house by house
items: Look west from Glessner's and Kimball's walks: the row of stand-in houses on Indiana Avenue between 18th and 20th Street is replaced by the houses the 1911 fire-insurance map draws there, each on its own lot. That is 22 houses, among them a stone-fronted row at 1801-1807 and three pairs of twin houses, plus three frame flats on 18th Street and 13 stables and sheds on the alley.

The ten addresses where the 1904 Blue Book lists households now each stand on their own lots. The post-office sub-station and the corner store at 20th Street are left open until someone finds what stood there in 1904.
